cmd:
# Kill any hanging sudo/curl processes
pkill -f 'curl.*gitea' 2>/dev/null
pkill -f 'sudo.*curl' 2>/dev/null

# Download to home dir (no sudo needed)
echo 'Downloading Gitea to ~/...'
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 'https://dl.gitea.com/gitea/1.24.0/gitea-1.24.0-linux-amd64' -o ~/gitea 2>&1
chmod +x ~/gitea
ls -la ~/gitea
echo '---'
~/gitea --version 2>&1
